reviewed_evidence.topic: Cover identity, partial membership and timing
reviewed_evidence.assessment: Image digest, role, description and ordered list comparison explain shared/varying states. Existing partial entries preserve membership unless all_files chosen; new staged images use all_files. Manage OK, direct mutation and external extraction are distinguished. MP4 Other and ID3v1 limits are scoped without all-format claims.

reviewed_evidence.topic: Alternate sort fields, native compilation flags and list sorting
reviewed_evidence.assessment: Artist display versus separate optional sort expression matches source/model. Native ID3/MP4 1-or-deletion constraints and unsupported zero/true behavior match actual generated-MP3 fixtures and mapping; no player-grouping guarantee.

reviewed_evidence.topic: ReplayGain metadata and conditional APE migration
reviewed_evidence.assessment: All migration conditions and existing-field precedence match production source. Written roundtrip/deletion and three migration cases use generated MP3s and retain audio bytes. Invented gain values are expressly not analysis/normalization instructions; original audio, metadata and playback behavior are separated.
